scripts.text:
delete from [dw].[AM_F_TimeSheet]  
  where 
  [AM_TimeSheetMonthYear] =(
  (select CONVERT(varchar,datepart(mm,Run_Eff_DT))
  +'-'+
  CONVERT(varchar,datepart(yyyy,Run_Eff_DT) )
  from dbo.Ctrl_Run where Status_Code='Running'))

SQL1.value: 'SELECT TimeSheetSK,TimeSheetID,TimeSheetTitle,TimeSheetDate,TimeTaken,TimeSheetMajorTaskSK,TimeSheetProjectSK,TimeSheetProjectResourceSK,TimeSheetTaskCategorySK,TimeSheetTaskCategoryTypeSK,TimeSheetMinorTaskSk,TimeSheetDateSK,DW_Run_Key,DW_Create_Datetime,DW_Update_Datetime,TimeTakenHR,TimeSheetDefectSk FROM  dw.F_TimeSheet where TimeSheetProjectResourceSK = 944 AND datepart(mm,TimeSheetDateSK)=10 AND datepart(yyyy,TimeSheetDateSK)=2011'

SQL.value: 'SELECT ISNULL(TimeSheet.TimesheetProjectResourceSk ,ProjectResource.ProjectResourceSk) AS TimesheetProjectResourceSk,ISNULL(TimeSheet.TimeSheetProjectSK,ProjectResource.ProjectResourceProjectSK) AS TimeSheetProjectSK,ProjectResource.[ProjectResourcePmPodEnableFlag],ProjectResourceEnableTimesheetFlag,ISNULL(TimeSheet.TimeSheetTaskCategoryTypeSK,-3) TimeSheetTaskCategoryTypeSK,TimeSheet.TimeSheetDateSK,isnull(TimeSheet.TimeTaken,0) AS TimeTaken,isnull(TimeSheet.TimeTakenHR,0.00) as TimeTakenHR  from dw.D_ProjectResources as projectresource left outer join (select * from dw.F_TimeSheet WHERE  (DATEPART(mm, TimeSheetDate)=0) AND (DATEPART(yyyy, TimeSheetDate) =(SELECT DATEPART(yyyy, Run_Eff_DT) AS Expr1 FROM dbo.Ctrl_Run WHERE  (Status_Code = 'Running')))) as timesheet on (projectresource.ProjectResourceSK=timesheet.TimeSheetProjectResourceSK)'

source.sqlReaderQuery:
select TimeSheetProjectSK,
TimeSheetProjectResourceSK,
TimeSheetTaskCategoryTypeSK,
TimeSheetDateSK from DW.F_TimeSheet
where DW_Run_Key=? and
Datepart(mm,TimeSheetDate)<>?

scripts.text:
delete from dw.AM_F_TimeSheet where AM_TimeSheetMonthYear=  CONVERT(varchar,DATEPART(mm,@timesheetdateSK))+'-'+CONVERT(varchar,DATEPART(yyyy,@timesheetdateSK))
and AM_TimeSheetProjectResourceSK in (select ProjectResourceSK from dw.D_ProjectResources
										where ProjectResourcesID = (select ProjectResourcesID  from dw.D_ProjectResources
																	where ProjectResourceSK =@projectResourceSK)
										and ProjectResourceProjectSK in (select projectsk from dw.D_Projects 
																		 where ProjectID = (select ProjectID from dw.D_Projects 
																							where ProjectSK = @projectSK))
									)

select distinct(datepart(mm,TimeSheetDateSK)),datepart(yyyy,TimeSheetDateSK)
from dw.F_TimeSheet
where
 TimeSheetProjectResourceSK=@projectResourceSK
and TimeSheetDateSK=@timesheetdateSK
